scientific_integrity: Full analytic proof with a finite exact-arithmetic checker; no independent validation or claimed certification.
scientific_limitations: Only the spherical vs nonspherical status of the true Löwner ellipsoid is classified, with full ellipsoid dimensions given in the spherical regime; no nonround semiaxes formula. Positive simplex weight only. Finite verification supplements an all-parameter analytic proof. Historical priority remains provisional; earlier published radius/contact and inball results are excluded from novelty.
title: A sharp spherical-Löwner phase boundary for simplex-weighted harmonic polytopes
